Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add autocomplete ghost text system and context pills for chat

Autocomplete System:
- Add TipTap extensions for inline ghost text using ProseMirror decorations
- Implement keyboard shortcuts: Tab \(accept\), Ctrl+Right \(accept word\), Escape \(dismiss\), Alt+/ \(manual trigger\)
- Add LRU cache with TTL \(1000 entries, 5min\) to reduce API calls
- Add auto/manual trigger mode toggle in editor toolbar
- Smart trigger after spaces, punctuation; request cancellation via AbortController

Chat Context Pills \(Cursor-style\):
- Replace chat prefill with collapsible Context Pills UI
- Support multiple selections sent to chat simultaneously
- Show selected text as expandable pills with char count
- Contexts displayed in both chat input and message history
- Clear contexts after sending message

Quick Edit Menu:
- Fix submenu rendering to prevent viewport clipping
- Add translation options: Spanish, French, German, Japanese
- Add tone options: Friendly, Confident
- Fix click-outside behavior during processing

New files:
- src/extensions/autocomplete-extension.ts
- src/extensions/autocomplete-keymap.ts
- server/services/autocomplete_cache.py

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add modal-based link and image insertion with link bubble menu

Link & Image Modals:
- Replace window.prompt with proper modal dialogs for link/image insertion
- Add reusable Modal, ModalHeader, ModalFooter UI components
- LinkModal with URL input and Enter key support
- ImageModal with URL and optional alt text fields
- Used in toolbar, bubble menu, and slash commands

Link Bubble Menu:
- Add dedicated bubble menu for existing links \(appears on cursor hover\)
- Shows URL preview with truncation
- Actions: copy link, edit inline, open in new tab, remove link
- Edit mode with inline URL input and Enter/Escape handling
- Separate from text selection bubble menu

Editor Improvements:
- Bubble menu now only shows on text selection \(not on link hover\)
- Slash command /image now opens ImageModal via global store
- Image modal callback pattern for async modal results

New files:
- src/components/ui/modal.tsx - Reusable modal with backdrop and animations
- src/components/editor/link-modal.tsx - Link URL input modal
- src/components/editor/image-modal.tsx - Image URL/alt input modal
- src/components/editor/link-bubble-menu.tsx - Link editing bubble menu

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
